content.short: Demex is a cross-chain decentralized derivatives exchange specializing in perpetuals and sophisticated DeFi tools.
content.description: Demex is a leading non-custodial decentralized exchange designed to provide a professional-grade trading experience for perpetual contracts, spot markets, and advanced financial products. Built on the Carbon network and utilizing the Cosmos SDK, Demex enables seamless cross-chain trading with deep liquidity and high throughput. The platform features an on-chain order book that ensures transparency and fair price discovery, while its sophisticated margin system allows for capital-efficient trading with high leverage. Demex focuses on providing users with a comprehensive suite of DeFi tools, including liquidity pools and staking rewards, creating a robust and inclusive environment for global decentralized finance innovation.
content.meta: Demex is a premier cross-chain decentralized exchange, offering professional derivatives trading, spot markets, and advanced DeFi infrastructure.
